definition: Lemma J key exactly as n7/aggregate_n7.py d_key: (integer characteristic polynomial of A, sorted multiset over vertices of the in-walk sequences ((A^T)^k 1)_i, k = 1..8).  Theorem J.2 (notes/lemma_J_equivalence.md): equal keys <=> same full-support data D(A) = (d, phi, omega, multiset a_i) <=> identical full-support region for every (eps, delta).
note_on_vanishing_labels: a_i names are vertex-indexed positivity polynomials; D-equivalence preserves their multiset only, so a2 vs a3 at the same root is the same datum
